name: VertigoAd AI Comments
author: setupadlt

sections.description:
This plugin generates draft comments (pending approval) for selected posts.

Privacy

This plugin connects to a 3rd-party service (OpenAI API) to generate draft comments.

When generating comments, the plugin sends the selected post content (text) to the OpenAI API.
The plugin does not send visitor IP addresses automatically and does not store the API response outside WordPress comments.
You must provide your own OpenAI API key in the plugin settings.

External service:
OpenAI API (https://api.openai.com)

Terms & Privacy:
https://openai.com/policies
